items.title: Characterizations of strict morphisms of finite filtered objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six equivalent conditions on a morphism of finite filtered objects: strictness, the canonical map from coimage to image being an isomorphism, the same after applying the associated graded functor, exactness of the two short sequences of graded pieces and of the four-term sequence of graded pieces (statement lines 5234-5259). The proof is a complete argument: the first equivalence is the general characterization of strictness, and the equivalence with the three exactness conditions is attributed to a named lemma on short exact sequences and graded objects (proof lines 5262-5267); the remaining implication is reduced to showing that a map which is injective, surjective and an isomorphism on the associated graded maps each filtration step onto the corresponding one, which is done by descending induction using a commutative diagram with short exact rows and the five lemma (proof lines 5268-5290). The non-formal content is the descending induction. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
